name: Exp_iCCI_NR
summary: This EA trades based on the iCCI_NR custom indicator, a doubly-smoothed CCI (Commodity Channel Index) variant. It generates buy signals when the indicator crosses upward from zero and sell signals when it crosses downward from four, with configurable position opening and closing logic. The EA uses dual smoothing methods for the CCI calculation to reduce noise and improve signal quality.
summary_zh: 该EA基于iCCI_NR自定义指标进行交易，这是一个双重平滑的CCI（商品通道指数）变体。当指标从零向上穿越时产生买入信号，从四向下穿越时产生卖出信号，并支持可配置的开仓和平仓逻辑。该EA使用双平滑方法处理CCI计算以减少噪声并提高信号质量。
strategy_analysis: 策略概念基于双重平滑的CCI指标，通过两次不同方法的移动平均平滑处理原始CCI值，以过滤噪声产生更可靠的交易信号。入场条件为：当CCI_NR指标从0线向上穿越时开多单，从4线向下穿越时开空单，且需要前后两根K线的指标值对比来确认穿越。出场条件为：当指标值大于2时平多单，小于2时平空单，同时支持固定点数的止损和止盈。仓位管理采用TradeAlgorithms.mqh库提供的多种资金管理模式，包括基于可用保证金、余额、亏损后保证金比例或固定手数。资金管理通过MM参数控制风险比例（默认0.1），并结合MMMode选择具体的仓位计算方式。信号仅在新的K线形成时检测，避免重复交易，同时使用SignalBar参数指定用于信号检测的K线索引。
strategy_analysis_en: The strategy concept is based on a doubly-smoothed CCI indicator that applies two separate smoothing methods to the raw CCI value, filtering noise to produce more reliable trading signals. Entry conditions: a buy signal is generated when the CCI_NR indicator crosses upward from the zero level, and a sell signal is generated when it crosses downward from the four level, requiring comparison of two consecutive bar values to confirm the crossover. Exit conditions: long positions are closed when the indicator value exceeds 2, and short positions are closed when it falls below 2, with configurable fixed stop-loss and take-profit in points. Position sizing uses the TradeAlgorithms.mqh library offering multiple money management modes including free margin-based, balance-based, loss-adjusted margin, or fixed lot sizing. Money management is controlled by the MM parameter (default 0.1 risk ratio) combined with MMMode for specific lot calculation. Signals are only detected on new bar formation to prevent duplicate trades, with the SignalBar parameter specifying which bar index to use for signal detection.

parameters.name: MM
parameters.description: 资金管理比例，控制每笔交易的风险占比
parameters.description_en: Money management ratio, risk per trade

parameters.name: MMMode
parameters.description: 资金管理模式：可用保证金/余额/亏损保证金/固定手数
parameters.description_en: MM mode: free margin/balance/loss margin/fixed lot

parameters.name: IPC
parameters.description: 应用于CCI计算的价格类型
parameters.description_en: Price type applied to CCI calculation

parameters.name: SignalBar
parameters.description: 用于信号检测的K线索引

pros: 双重平滑CCI有效减少虚假信号，提高信号可靠性
支持多种资金管理模式，灵活适应不同交易风格和账户规模
设有止损和止盈，具备基本风险控制
新K线检测机制避免同一信号重复入场
可独立控制开多、开空、平多、平空，提供精细的交易控制
pros_en: Doubly-smoothed CCI effectively reduces false signals and improves signal reliability
Multiple money management modes provide flexibility for different trading styles and account sizes
Stop-loss and take-profit are configured, providing basic risk control
New bar detection mechanism prevents duplicate entries on the same signal
Independent control over buy open, sell open, buy close, and sell close offers granular trade control
cons: 依赖自定义指标iCCI_NR，缺乏对该指标内部逻辑的可审查性
没有价差过滤，在高价差环境下可能产生不利成交
止损1000点和止盈2000点默认值偏大，可能不适合所有品种和周期
缺乏对已有持仓数量的检查，可能重复开仓
没有时间过滤机制，可能在低流动性时段交易
cons_en: Depends on the custom iCCI_NR indicator without visibility into its internal logic for audit
No spread filter, which may result in unfavorable fills in high-spread environments
Default stop-loss of 1000 points and take-profit of 2000 points are large and may not suit all instruments and timeframes
No check on existing position count, potentially allowing duplicate position openings
No time filter mechanism, may trade during low-liquidity sessions
improvements: 增加价差过滤，当价差超过阈值时禁止开仓
增加持仓数量检查，防止同方向重复开仓
添加交易时段过滤，避开低流动性时段
improvements_en: Add a spread filter to prohibit opening positions when the spread exceeds a threshold
Add position count checking to prevent duplicate opening in the same direction
Add trading session filtering to avoid low-liquidity periods

risk_points: 没有检查当前已有持仓数量，可能在同方向重复开仓导致过度暴露
缺少价差过滤，高价差环境下止损可能被扩大滑点触发
依赖外部自定义指标，如果指标加载失败EA将无法运行
risk_points_en: No check on existing position count, potentially over-exposing in the same direction with duplicate openings
No spread filter means stop-losses may be triggered with widened slippage in high-spread conditions
Dependency on external custom indicator means the EA cannot operate if the indicator fails to load

The EA uses dual smoothing methods for the CCI calculation to reduce noise and improve signal quality.
